summary: Atlas Energy Solutions filed an 8-K under Items 7.01, 8.01 and 9.01 disclosing that its indirect subsidiary ProjectCo entered into two purchase commitments for an aggregate 283 MW of Caterpillar natural gas generation equipment outside its existing Global Framework Agreement with Caterpillar. The purchases are supported by separate cost reimbursement agreements with a leading frontier AI lab, the intended offtaker for the power project. No securities transaction, stake, price, premium or close date is stated, and no board recommendation or advisor is named. This is a routine commercial equipment/power-supply disclosure, not a special situation.
